title: Classic Loaded Nachos
description: Classic Loaded Nachos are layered with seasoned taco-style beef, black beans, melted cheese, and fresh toppings for the ultimate Mexican appetizer or casual main. Every bite delivers crispy tortilla chips, gooey cheese, and vibrant garnishes.

ingredients.title: For the Nachos
items: Tortilla chips – 1 large bag (restaurant-style, thick-cut for sturdiness)
Queso fresco – ½ cup, crumbled (for garnish)

ingredients.title: For the Toppings
items: Black beans – 1 cup, rinsed and drained
Fresh jalapeños – 2, thinly sliced (or pickled, for milder flavor)
Sour cream or Mexican crema – ½ cup, for drizzling

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Beef
steps: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Sauté onion in a little oil until translucent, then add garlic.
Add beef (or chorizo) and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles.
Stir in the spices, season with salt and pepper, then fold in black beans.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Build the Nachos
steps: On a sheet pan, spread half the chips in an even layer.
Top with half the beef-bean mixture and half the cheeses.
Repeat with the remaining chips, meat, and cheese.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Bake
steps: Place in the oven for 7–10 minutes, until cheese is fully melted and bubbling.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Finish & Garnish
steps: Scatter over jalapeños, tomatoes, avocado, scallions, and cilantro.
Drizzle with crema or serve sour cream on the side.
Sprinkle queso fresco on top for authentic flavor.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve immediately while the cheese is hot and melted.
Pair with salsa, guacamole, or pico de gallo.
Enjoy as an appetizer for 4–6 people or a main course for 2–3.

chefTips: Layering is key: Building nachos in two layers ensures every chip gets toppings.
Cheese blend: Sharp cheddar for flavor, Monterey Jack for melt, queso fresco for authenticity.
Optional upgrades: Pickled red onions, roasted corn, or a drizzle of chipotle aioli.
Presentation: Serve directly on the sheet tray lined with parchment, or on a wooden board for a rustic restaurant look.
